messages.text: Shop···· and Marcus J.

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Thanks for the order details, Marcus.

To sort the fault itself, I need one thing first: which model is it, and what exactly is it doing? For example no power at all, fans spin but no hashrate, or an error on the screen. If there's anything on the display or in the web UI, a photo or screenshot helps a lot.
Shop···· and Marcus J.

Thanks, I have that, Marcus. The order side is with the team.

For my part I just need two things about the unit itself:

1. Which model is it (for example NerdQaxe++, Hammer BC04, Harlo B30)?
2. What is it doing right now: no power at all, fans spin but no hashrate, or an error on the screen or in the web UI?

A photo of the screen or a screenshot of the web UI is ideal if you can take one.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Got the photo, thanks. I can see a white label on the side of a black unit with a CE mark, a barcode and the code (number hidden), with a cable entering at the left edge. That reads as the serial / ID label rather than the screen, so it tells me which unit it is but not what it is doing.

Two things so I can get moving:

1. Which model is this one (NerdQaxe++, Hammer BC04, Harlo B30, something else)?
2. What happens when you power it on: nothing at all, fans spin but no hashrate, or an error on the screen or in the web UI?

A short video of the power-on attempt would settle most of it in one go.
Bs-2 and and i believe the cooling pump is broken
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Used rma verdict

Thanks, that gives me the serial ((number hidden)) and the model: a Bitfortun BS-2.

A dead pump on the BS-2 shows up in a very specific way, so let me confirm it rather than guess. One check first:

With the unit plugged in and running for a minute, put your hand on the pump housing and listen closely.
1. Is there any hum or faint vibration at all, or is it completely silent and still?
2. What temperature does the web UI show, and does the hashrate hold or drop to zero after a minute or two?

If you can send a short video with sound, about 20 seconds of it running, plus a screenshot of the web UI showing temps and hashrate, I can tell straight away whether it is the pump, the pump's power lead, or the unit throttling for another reason.
Bs-2 and and i believe the cooling pump is broken, it's just flashing red and doing a scratching sound
Let me check that red flash pattern against Bitfortun's own docs before I tell you what it means.
Searched the web · Bitfortun BS-2 flashing red light pump error
Searched the web · Bitfortun BS-2 manual LED status indicator

Unplug it for now, please. A water cooled unit that is alarming and grinding should not keep running: without flow the BM1373 chips and the regulators heat up fast.

Honest note on the light: I checked Bitfortun's own material and the BS-2 product page, and there is no published table for the red flash pattern, so I will not guess what that specific blink means. What I can work with is the sound.

One check, with the unit unplugged and cool:

1. Look into the fan on the radiator. Is a wire, a cable tie or the shroud touching the blades, and does the fan spin freely when you nudge it with a finger?
2. Then plug it back in for about 15 seconds and tell me where the scratching comes from: the fan on the radiator, or the small pump block sitting on the chips.

A grinding fan is a part we can sort. A grinding pump is a different matter and I need to know which one it is. A short video with sound, close to the unit, would answer both at once.
No cables it touching the the fan

Good, that rules out the easy one.

Second half of the check, and this is the one that decides it: plug it in for about 15 seconds and put your ear close.

1. Does the scratching come from the radiator fan, or from the small pump block sitting on top of the chips?
2. Does the fan itself spin up normally when you power it on?

Quickest way: a short video with sound held near the unit while it does it. Then I know whether it is a fan I can get replaced or the pump, and I pass my findings straight to the team.
And it sounds from the pump, not the fan
Used rma verdict
Handing back to Sarah.
